description: Unix timestamps to UTC dates in ISO 8601. text holds one or more timestamps, one per line: whole seconds or milliseconds, where a magnitude of 100000000000 or more is milliseconds. The answer is a CSV of input, unit and date. It refuses empty text, more than 1,048,576 bytes or 10,000 lines, and any line that is not digits with an optional leading minus inside the years 0001 to 9999. Free. The answer is the JSON envelope of https://foundry.dap.solutions/api/convert-unix-timestamp-to-date, byte for byte, with the artifact hash that answered. Full rules: https://foundry.dap.solutions/hub.md

text.description: One or more Unix timestamps, one per line: whole seconds or milliseconds, digits with an optional leading minus, inside the years 0001 to 9999. At most 1,048,576 bytes of UTF-8 and 10,000 lines; a line break at the very end is not a line.

name: convert-unix-timestamp-to-date
title: Convert Unix timestamp to date
